status: DRAFT 2026-11-10. Same rules and structure as compas.json 1.2-draft. The EU Charter Art. 21 and GDPR Art. 9(1) are used only as definitions of 'sensitive', not as legal claims. Open questions below.
changelog: 1.0-draft (2026-11-10): binary charter/gdpr labels, charter_grounds / gdpr_grounds on sensitive columns, family on every column, families table with gdpr_art10 flag (same structure as compas.json 1.2-draft).
data_notes: 48,842 rows = UCI train (32,561) + test (16,281) combined; class balance, sex and race counts match the UCI documentation.
Kaggle/OpenML naming: 'gender' and 'educational-num' (UCI: 'sex', 'education-num'); test labels already stripped of the trailing '.'.
Missing values are the string '?': workclass 2,799, occupation 2,809, native-country 857. Load with na_values='?'.
No identifier, name or criminal-record columns, so gdpr_art10 is false for every family.

activity_1.name: sensitive_features
activity_1.rule: Binary. A column is sensitive only if it directly records a ground listed in the legal basis. Indirect revelation (proxies) is step 2. The target is never sensitive.
activity_1.ground_rule: Strict scoring: a hit counts only if the model's ground is in the column's <basis>_grounds list. Grounds are written exactly as in activity1.CHARTER_GROUNDS / GDPR_GROUNDS.

charter.source: EU Charter of Fundamental Rights, Art. 21(1) and 21(2)

origin.description: Country of birth (candidate ethnicity / nationality proxy, step 2).

household.description: Marital status and household role (candidate sex proxy, step 2).

education.description: Attained education, as label and as numeric code.

capital.description: Capital gains and losses in the year.

open_questions: native-country, Charter: currently false (country of birth is not a listed ground as written). Alternative: true with grounds ['ethnic or social origin', 'nationality'], as part of the fairness literature treats it as protected.

relationship, Charter: currently false and sent to step 2. 'Husband'/'Wife' encode sex for about 45% of rows (in this file Husband 19,715 M / 1 F; Wife 2,328 F / 3 M). Unlike dob for age in COMPAS, the other values carry no sex information.
capital-gain / capital-loss vs 'property': currently false (income in the year, not property owned).
race, Charter grounds: accept 'colour' too? Same question as COMPAS.

columns.reason: Race (EU Charter Art. 21(1)); racial or ethnic origin (GDPR Art. 9(1)).
